Extends the workflow-failure-heal pipeline (#4165) with a third reporter: the reusable `review_autofix.yml` now reports its own repeated failures to the heal intake, so a pull request whose AI review/autofix keeps failing for the same reason gets a hotfix issue in this repo instead of only a Telegram alert and an endless poller retry.

Follow-up to the `❌ ERROR: PR autofix failed` alert on #4174 (run 35551938072, `editor_empty_noop`), which the label-based heal could not see because retryable editor failures never apply an escalation label.

## What changes

- **`review_autofix.yml`** — new `Report autofix failure to workflow failure heal` step in the failure path (`continue-on-error`, gated on `vars.WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED`, skipped for closed PRs, branch-review mode, and resolver escalations). The iteration-summary step also persists the `REVIEW_AUTOFIX_RUN_SUMMARY_V1` line to the runtime dir so the reporter can read `finalize_reason`.
- **`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh`** (new) — derives the failure reason from the editor flags / summary line, counts consecutive failure comments on the PR (no extra API read), skips below `WORKFLOW_HEAL_AUTOFIX_FAILURE_STREAK` (default 2), collects bounded evidence (summary line, flags, log tails), builds the payload and sends one `repository_dispatch` to the upstream repo. Always exits 0.
- **`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`** — additive `source_kind: autofix_failure` (`build_autofix_failure_payload`, `count_autofix_failure_streak`, validation of `failure_reason` / `failure_streak` / `failure_evidence`, issue title/body variants with an UNTRUSTED evidence block, `build-autofix-payload` and `autofix-failure-streak` CLI subcommands).

2026-09-21T11:06:05.7341106Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Extends the workflow-failure-heal pipeline (#4165) with a third reporter: the reusable `review_autofix.yml` now reports its own repeated failures to the heal intake, so a pull request whose AI review/autofix keeps failing for the same reason gets a hotfix issue in this repo instead of only a Telegram alert and an endless poller retry.
